definitions.gloss: white night; midnight sun; polar summer daylight
definitions.explanation: The phenomenon in high latitudes near the summer solstice when the sun does not set, or sets so briefly that the sky never grows fully dark. Associated in Japan above all with Northern Europe and the polar regions.

examples.japanese: {白夜|びゃくや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧。

examples.english: I experienced the midnight sun in Scandinavia.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION: The standard reading is びゃくや; はくや is an older reading still listed in some dictionaries.

RELATED WORDS:
- {極夜|きょくや}: polar night, when the sun does not rise (the winter opposite)
- ⟦{北極|ほっきょく}→北極：16689_hokkyoku⟧・⟦{南極|なんきょく}→南極：11936_nankyoku⟧: the Arctic, the Antarctic

CULTURAL NOTE: The word evokes Northern European summers and appears in titles such as Higashino Keigo's novel {白夜行|びゃくやこう}.
